must_not_contain: Basis of Design Total Installed Cost Estimating

metadata.description: A competencies block laid out as rows renders as rows. Each row begins a line in the PDF rather than being run into its predecessor.
metadata.regression_of: 2026-09-25: Roger's hand-written Heaven Hill resume lays its competencies out as ten pipe-delimited rows. Markdown treats consecutive lines as one paragraph, so the render joined them and ten scannable rows became a wall of text reading 'Options Analysis Total Installed Cost Estimating'. No content was lost, which is why the QA pass missed it: it checked for missing strings and artifacts, not for preserved line structure. One resume of sixty was affected, and it was the one Roger opened first.
